claims.text: Nematus implements an attentional encoder–decoder architecture similar to the one described by Bahdanau et al.
The architecture of Nematus includes concatenation of forward and backward encoder RNN hidden states for source annotations.
Nematus is implemented in Python and based on the Theano framework, enhancing its usability and performance.
